import numpy as np
def anchors(fn):
    p = fn(100.0, 3.0, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 9, 50000, 2, 314159)
    idx = [(0, 1, 0), (0, 9, 1), (7, 4, 0), (123, 6, 1), (25000, 2, 0), (49999, 9, 1)]
    return np.array([float(p.shape[0]), float(p.shape[1]), float(p.shape[2])]
                    + [p[i, j, k] for i, j, k in idx])
assert np.allclose(anchors(simulate_gbm_paths), target)
